**Management Summary – Project LV 160,242 €**

The bid contains numerous specification gaps that expose the contract to compliance risk and potential cost overruns. Medium‑severity omissions (≈ 9 items, € 9,800) relate to mandatory VOB/C/DIN data: missing homogen‑area classification, insulation thickness, thermal conductivity, water‑exposure class, and related GEG evidence. Low‑severity gaps (≈ 7 items, € 3,500) affect paving, asphalt, mortar, edge insulation, plaster, exposure class, and shaft details. Immediate actions: (1) revise all affected work packages to include the required DIN 18300/18331, DIN 18533, and GEG parameters; (2) obtain specialist input for thermal‑performance and water‑exposure classifications; (3) update the cost estimate to reflect added material specifications and potential re‑work. Prompt correction will safeguard tender acceptance and limit claim exposure.
